Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing county commissioners to be elected by district.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to county commissioner elections; and amending RCW36.32.050.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 36.32.050 and 1963 c 4 s 36.32.050 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as provided under subsection (2) of this section, countycommissioners shall be elected by the ((qualified)) registered votersof the entire county and the person receiving the highest number ofvotes for the office of commissioner for the district in which he orshe resides shall be declared duly elected from that district. (2) In a noncharter county west of the crest of the Cascademountains with a population greater than three hundred thousand, thecommissioners shall be elected by commissioner district.
